questions.q: How does the Until activity differ from ForEach?
options: Until loops by condition until an expression is true; ForEach loops over a fixed collection
Until can only run once; ForEach can run indefinitely
They are functionally identical, just named differently
Until only works with SQL sources; ForEach works with any source
questions.explain: ForEach iterates a known number of times, once per item in a collection. Until repeats its activities with no fixed count, stopping only when its expression evaluates true.

questions.q: When is an Until activity's expression evaluated?
options: After every pass through the child activities
Only once, before the loop starts
Only if the pipeline has a trigger attached
Every second, regardless of the child activities' progress
questions.explain: The expression is checked after each pass through the child activities — if false, the loop runs again; once true, the Until activity completes.

questions.q: What happens if a child activity inside an Until loop fails?
options: The Until activity doesn't stop — it keeps looping until the expression is true or it times out
The entire pipeline immediately fails
The Until activity automatically skips to the next pipeline
The failed activity is silently removed from the loop
questions.explain: A failure inside the loop doesn't stop the Until activity itself — it keeps iterating until either the expression evaluates true or the timeout is reached.

questions.q: What is the default timeout for an Until activity, and the maximum allowed?
options: Default 7 days, maximum 90 days
Default 1 hour, maximum 24 hours
Default 10 minutes, maximum 1 day
There is no timeout — Until activities can run forever
questions.explain: Without an explicit timeout, Until defaults to 7 days. You can set it as high as 90 days — the timeout exists specifically to prevent a never-satisfied condition from looping indefinitely.

questions.q: What's a common real-world pattern using the Until activity?
options: Polling an external system's status with a Web activity and a Wait, repeated until it reports complete
Permanently disabling a pipeline's trigger
Converting a Copy activity into a Lookup activity
Replacing the need for any linked service
questions.explain: Until plus Wait plus a status check (often a Web activity) is the standard way to poll an asynchronous external process until it's actually finished.
